hooks.name: Safety and style check after each task
hooks.description: After a spec task is done, checks the changed files against safety.md, product.md and style.md.

action.prompt: Review the files changed by the task that just finished against .kiro/steering/safety.md, product.md and style.md. Check: (1) a crisis answer removes every staircase, ghost, cobweb and moon element and shows only the server message, helpUrl and one Back to the start button; (2) user phrases are rendered with textContent or SVG text nodes, never innerHTML; (3) no network call except analyze_ladder to https://108psy.com/mcp, no analytics, no external fonts; (4) no prices or subscription offers; (5) Aizhan Li is never called a psychologist or therapist; (6) animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion; (7) no jump scares, skulls, blood or sound. Fix any violation you find and list what you changed in one short paragraph.
